html:
Question 4
?

Given that y>20 and t>0, which of the following is an inhibited decay equation?

a
dydt=−80y(20−y)
b
dydt=80(y+20)
c
dydt=−80(y−20)
d
dydt=−80(20−y)
e
dydt=80y(y+20)
Submit
